pipeline.description: vscode spike 7.1 metrics probe, safe to delete
pipeline.config_yaml:
input:
  generate:
    interval: 100ms
    mapping: 'root = {"n": counter()}'
pipeline:
  processors:
    - label: fast
      mapping: 'root = this'
    - label: slow
      sleep:
        duration: 5ms
    - label: erratic
      mapping: 'root = if this.n % 10 == 0 { throw("erratic failure") } else { this }'
output:
  drop: {}
